env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

env CC=
env CGO_ENABLED=

[!race] skip 'the platform has no race detector'
[!cgo] skip 'a Go main module needs the default C compiler on PATH'

cd forbid

# A Go main module (no .lgo file) keeps the upstream default for
# CGO_ENABLED under logos, and the cgo key has no effect: the race
# runtime still links in deps, and no policy refusal appears.
! stderr 'requires cgo'
logos list -race -test -deps -f '{{.ImportPath}}' ./pure
! stderr 'requires cgo'
stdout '^runtime/race$'
# The race runtime links runtime/cgo everywhere but darwin.
[!GOOS:darwin] stdout '^runtime/cgo$'
# net carries cgo files on unix platforms other than darwin (whose
# resolver uses syscall wrappers and imports no C) and not on Windows.
[!GOOS:windows] [!GOOS:darwin] logos list -race -test -deps -f '{{if eq .ImportPath "net"}}cgo={{.CgoFiles}}{{end}}' ./pure
[!GOOS:windows] [!GOOS:darwin] ! stderr 'requires cgo'
[!GOOS:windows] [!GOOS:darwin] stdout 'cgo=\[.+'
# cgouse imports C directly, so the dep graph holds a cgo user on every
# platform where CGO_ENABLED=1, darwin included: a forbid policy wrongly
# applied to a Go module refuses here instead of passing vacuously.
[cgo] logos list -race -test -deps -f '{{.ImportPath}}' ./pure
[cgo] ! stderr 'requires cgo'
[cgo] stdout '^example.com/forbidgomodule/cgouse$'

-- forbid/go.mod --
module example.com/forbidgomodule

go 1.27

-- forbid/logos.toml --
[build]
cgo = "forbid"

-- forbid/pure/pure.go --
package pure

func Add(a int, b int) int { return a + b }

-- forbid/pure/pure_test.go --
package pure

import (
	"net"
	"testing"
)

func TestAdd(t *testing.T) {
	if Add(1, 2) != 3 {
		t.Fatal("wrong sum")
	}
	if !net.ParseIP("127.0.0.1").IsLoopback() {
		t.Fatal("127.0.0.1 is not a loopback address")
	}
}

-- forbid/pure/pure_cgo_test.go --
//go:build cgo

package pure

import (
	"testing"

	"example.com/forbidgomodule/cgouse"
)

func TestCgoProbe(t *testing.T) {
	if cgouse.Answer() != 42 {
		t.Fatal("cgo probe failed")
	}
}

-- forbid/cgouse/cgouse.go --
package cgouse

/*
int logos_cgo_probe(void) { return 42; }
*/
import "C"

// Answer reports the value of the C probe function.
func Answer() int { return int(C.logos_cgo_probe()) }
